message.reasoning_content:
I'm idx1, influence 1, president is idx2. Need goods to sell later. Shuttle gives 4 goods free of charge — no bribe needed. Bribe 10 to idx2 would make influence 3, but still idx2 has 1... president is highest influence; idx0 has 2. To become president I need influence 3 (tie broken by tie_order where I'm second — idx2 has priority). So need influence >2: bribe 10 to anyone gives 3, making me president. But presidency in round 3 law — value? Could veto tax laws. Cash cost 10M. Round 4 auction also matters.

Shuttle gives 4 goods worth later sales (~4-6 alashi each ≈ 20 alashi). Presidency matters in rounds 3-6 laws and the 5% bonus at end (max influence). Bribes also transfer cash to rival.

I think shuttle is best economically: 4 goods free. But influence bonus 5% of bank is small. Presidency could let me veto tax laws (tax hits my sales). Hard to say; simple pick: shuttle.
